stem: How many integers \(x\) satisfy the inequality \(1 \le 2x - 3 < 9\)?
solution: Divide all three parts by 2: \(2 \le x < 6\).
The integers are 2, 3, 4 and 5 (6 is not included), so there are 4 of them.
verify:
sols = [n for n in range(-50, 50) if 1 <= 2*n - 3 < 9]
assert sols == [2, 3, 4, 5]
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == [len(sols)]
